author: GameSpot
description:
Tune in to the Future Games Show Spring Showcase on Thursday, March 12, 2026. Viewers can expect exclusive trailers and developer deep dives on coveted AAA blockbusters and trailblazing indie games, curated by in-house experts.

This year’s Spring Showcase will arrive during the GDC Festival of Gaming broadcast schedule and will be immediately followed by FGS Live From, where the FGS editorial team will regale viewers with the most exciting games on the GDC show floor, as well as debuting more world premiere trailers and insightful developer interviews.
title: Future Games Spring Showcase 2026 Livestream
